info.title: Penny Wise - Economy Literacy Helper
info.description: This is a project created during the Summer Cohort in 20226 from [https://freecodecamp.org](https://freecodecamp.org). It is aimed for preteens and teenagers, and the goal is to teach basic economy literacy in a interactive way, which we hope to be a pleasant experience. Because the users are children we advise the parents or tutors to be side by side, with the learners.
